name: Solebury Orchards
description: In 3325 Creamery Road, PA, Solebury Orchards raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a independent farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
